CD4+ T cells.rationale: CD4 and CD3E are canonical markers for T cells, while IL2 and IFNG are functional markers for T helper cells. CD8A and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD8+ T cells and B cells.

CD8+ T cells.rationale: CD8A and CD3E are canonical markers for T cells, while GZMB and PRF1 are functional markers for cytotoxic T cells. CD4 and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD4+ T cells and B cells.

Regulatory T cells.rationale: FOXP3, CD4, and CD25 are canonical markers for regulatory T cells, while CTLA4 is a functional marker. CD8A and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD8+ T cells and B cells.

B cells.rationale: CD19, CD20, CD79A, and MS4A1 are canonical markers for B cells. CD3E and CD8A are negative markers to exclude T cells.

Plasma cells.rationale: CD138 and CD38 are surface markers for plasma cells, while IGHG1 and XBP1 are functional markers. CD19 and CD3E are negative markers to exclude B cells and T cells.

NK cells.rationale: NCAM1 and KLRD1 are surface markers for NK cells, while NKG7 and PRF1 are functional markers. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Monocytes/macrophages.rationale: CD14, CD68, CD163, and CSF1R are canonical markers for monocytes/macrophages. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Dendritic cells.rationale: CD11C, CD86, HLA-DRA, and CCR7 are canonical markers for dendritic cells. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Endothelial cells.rationale: PECAM1, CDH5, VEGFR2, and VWF are canonical markers for endothelial cells. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Fibroblasts / CAFs.rationale: ACTA2, COL1A1, FAP, and PDGFRB are canonical markers for fibroblasts. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Pericytes.rationale: PDGFRB, RGS5, NG2, and CD13 are canonical markers for pericytes. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Mast cells.rationale: KIT, FCER1A, CPA3, and TPSAB1 are canonical markers for mast cells. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.
